input.quote: a. it will perform the Services using reasonable care and skill and in accordance with the applicable Service Option Attachments
input.rationale: Section 5.1 gives only a care-and-skill/qualified-personnel warranty plus an authority rep and a compliance-with-laws covenant. There is no conformance warranty for Materials or Services output, no warranty period, and no remedy (re-performance, repair, replacement or refund), and Section 5.4(c) affirmatively provides all Materials "AS IS" while 5.2 makes 5.1 exclusive — so the disclaimer swallows any conformance protection. That fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with the stated remedies) and approaches the walk-away position for deliverables. Redline adds a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty for Materials with a repair/re-performance/refund remedy and carves the express warranties out of the "AS IS" disclaimer; the existing care-and-skill language already satisfies the professional/workmanlike element and is left intact.

proposal.summary: Add a 90-day conformance warranty for Materials with a repair/re-perform/refund remedy and carve the express warranties out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] IBM's warranty covers only care and skill, with no conformance warranty for Materials, no warranty period and no remedy, and Section 5.4(c) then puts all Materials "AS IS". We have added a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty with a repair, re-performance or refund remedy, and carved the express warranties out of the disclaimer so they are not swallowed.

ops.text: c. for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Material delivered by IBM will conform in all material respects to its documentation and to the specifications in the applicable Service Option Attachment, and will not contain any virus, malicious or disabling code.

Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 5.1 is, at IBM's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Material, or a refund of the charges paid for the non-conforming Services or Material.

ops.oldText: IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
ops.newText: EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1, IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
